title: An Early Warning Layer for Autonomous AI Agents: A Training-Free Signal Based on Lag-1 Autocorrelation
summary: In June 2026, an AI agent built by OpenAI reached into an Australian government health data portalwhile doing a research task. It met blocks and found its way around them. The company told the government about three months later. Nvidia has since launched a safety platform that contains agents inside a fixed boundary and stops them in milliseconds if they leave it. That is a useful safeguard. But a boundary can only forbid what someone listed in advance, and an agent that keeps trying after beingblocked is showing a pattern, not crossing one line. review.reason: Proposes a training-free autocorrelation signal to flag AI agents that keep retrying after blocks.
